items.q: How do I verify an eBuddha Digitech certificate?
items.a: Enter the certificate number in the box on this page and press Verify Certificate. The details of the certificate are shown if the number is genuine.
It is printed on the certificate. Ask the holder to share a copy if you are an employer.
No. The check is free and needs no login.
Learners who complete an eBuddha Digitech program, and participants who attend our live masterclasses, receive a certificate.
The learner's name, the program and the work completed, as recorded by eBuddha Digitech.

items.q: Is the certificate a government-recognised qualification?
items.a: It confirms completion of an eBuddha Digitech program. It is not a government-recognised degree unless we state so.

items.q: The number shows no result. What should I do?
items.a: Check each character, including zeros and the letter O, then try again. If it still fails, message us on WhatsApp at +91 84619 58162.

items.q: I found a mistake in my name or course on the certificate.
items.a: Email ebuddhadigitech@gmail.com with your enrolment details and a copy of the certificate, and our team will correct it.

items.q: How can an employer confirm a candidate trained with us?
items.a: Ask for the certificate number and verify it here, or write to us and we will confirm the details.

items.q: Can I check a masterclass participation certificate here?
items.a: Yes. Certificates of Participation from our masterclasses are verifiable on this page too.
